projects.title: Assistant Hub
projects.tagline: A personal agent hub that every project and tool reports into: tickets the owner closes, agents launched in one keystroke, and a morning news briefing.
projects.description:
A desktop drawer, a phone page and an MCP server over one ledger. Agent sessions, background jobs and the other projects on this site report into it as tickets; nothing counts as done until the owner confirms it.

The console side: one keystroke opens a ticket's own terminal with Claude Code or Codex already briefed on it, puts it away when the agent is done, and resumes the same conversation later, on this machine or from another one. windoalls and visual-impression grew out of it to keep track of which terminal holds which conversation.

Around it: a morning digital news briefing that scans hundreds of sources, files the day's stories under the topics being followed with short summaries, and turns a story into a reading item or a ticket; AI usage and quota at a glance; the machine's own vital signs; calendar capture from a screenshot; and page and booking watchers that report back.

projects.title: San11 Smart AI
projects.tagline: An unofficial smarter-AI mode for Romance of the Three Kingdoms XI, built on a reproducible study of how the original game AI actually decides.
projects.description:
The goal: rival rulers that plan like strong players, as a supplement that players load onto their own copy of the game. The project ships no game files.

It is still experimental, with nothing playable to hand out yet. The current work is reverse-engineering the original AI first: instrumented, replayable experiments, each recorded with its evidence and what it rules out, before any new strategy or learned policy is layered on top.

projects.title: PPG-PulseFlowBP
